description: Get real-time ADS-B state vectors for all aircraft currently registered to a specific origin country (e.g. Germany, United States). Filters the global ADS-B feed by the aircraft's registered country of origin from ICAO24 address blocks. Optionally narrow the geographic area using a bounding box (lamin/lomin/lamax/lomax). Returns ICAO24, callsign, position, altitude, velocity, and heading for each matching aircraft. Useful for counting or mapping the live air traffic of a specific country. Source: OpenSky Network — opensky-network.org. No auth, open access.

country.description: Origin country name to filter aircraft by (e.g. Germany, United States, France). Case-insensitive.

lamax.description: Optional maximum latitude to narrow the search area (decimal degrees)

lamin.description: Optional minimum latitude to narrow the search area (decimal degrees)

limit.description: Maximum number of matching aircraft to return (default 100, max 500)

lomax.description: Optional maximum longitude to narrow the search area (decimal degrees)

lomin.description: Optional minimum longitude to narrow the search area (decimal degrees)

name: opensky.traffic.states_country

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: OpenSky — Live Aircraft by Origin Country
